snapshot.text: Small public system being rebuilt after Hurricane Maria, funded largely through citizenship-by-investment and Chinese support. Dominica is building 14 polyclinics and a new hospital.

priorities.title: New polyclinics and hospital
priorities.text: 14 polyclinics and a state-of-the-art hospital funded by the citizenship programme.

priorities.title: Cuban health programme
priorities.text: The government announced changes to the Cuban medical programme.
